Type: swirled pattern area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: low pile woven fibers, speckled texture
Colors: ivory, cool grey, charcoal
Shape: rectangle, all-over swirling spiral pattern in dashed grey lines, flat low pile, light airy look
Feel: calm, soft, airy
Goes with: grey upholstery, dark wood floors, woven baskets; modern or transitional rooms

product.name: Rivet Modern Gust Swirled Rug, 5' x 8', Grey
product.description: 100% Polyester Imported Get lost in the hypnotizing swirls of this soft, yet durable, area rug. Its neutral tones of gray and white allow it to blend effortlessly with your existing décor. Intricate swirled design Textured, raised patterns Low, 0.2" pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 5' x 8' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
